macros.name: dashbox
macros.doc: \dashbox[width][pos]{text} works like \framebox, but the box is drawn with dashed lines .

macros.name: dashbox
macros.doc: \dashbox[width][pos]{text} works like \framebox, but the box is drawn with dashed lines .

macros.name: dashdash
macros.doc: \dashdash gives the length of a dash.

macros.name: dashlength
macros.doc: \dashlength gives the length of a dash plus the following gap.

macros.name: dbox
macros.doc: \dbox{text} works like \fbox, but the box is drawn with dashed lines .

macros.name: dlbox
macros.doc: \dlbox[layers]{text} works like \lbox, but the boxes are drawn with dashed lines .

macros.name: dlbox
macros.doc: \dlbox[layers]{text} works like \lbox, but the boxes are drawn with dashed lines .

macros.name: layersize
macros.doc: \layersize gives the protrusion of each layer below the previous one.
